ruleDefinitions.name: Unauthorized System Time Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect scenarios where a potentially unauthorized application or user is modifying the system time. Note: Unmapped fields: ProcessName, SubjectUserSid

sequences.query: event_id = 4616 AND  NOT ((ProcessName = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\vmtoolsd\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\VBoxService\.exe" OR ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\oobe\\msoobe\.exe") OR (ProcessName = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost\.exe" AND SubjectUserSid = "S\-1\-5\-19"))
